# @mono-agent/advisor-mcp

Expose one bounded, review-only Streamable HTTP MCP tool backed by a
mono-agent responder.

## Responsibility

Serve a long-lived, stateless HTTP MCP endpoint whose single public tool,
`review_iteration`, submits caller-provided intent, patch, and verification
text to one explicitly selected model/effort route. A stable `session_key`
retains review continuity while the package-owned cache stores only hashed,
bounded metadata. The configured responder still follows the host's normal
history, run-artifact, observability, and memory policies.

This is a plugin-tier package. It publishes in the mono-agent lockstep, but it
is not part of the core `@mono-agent/agent-app` closure. The app loads it only
when declared under `channels.plugins[]`.

## Install / Usage

Install the same version as the app:

```bash
pnpm add @mono-agent/agent-app@latest @mono-agent/advisor-mcp@latest
```

Then add the plugin to `mono-agent.config.json`. The Pi route below is
intentional: advisor turns get an authoritative empty tool/MCP policy, which
direct Codex, direct OpenCode, and Claude CLI cannot enforce.

The host primary must also be in a compatible runtime family. In particular, a
host configured with direct `codex:*` cannot cross that runtime boundary for an
advisor `pi:*` request; the review fails visibly instead of changing backends.

```json
{
  "channels": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "package": "@mono-agent/advisor-mcp",
        "id": "advisor",
        "config": {
          "enabled": true,
          "host": "127.0.0.1",
          "port": 4312,
          "path": "/mcp",
          "model": "pi:openai-codex:gpt-5.6-sol",
          "effort": "max",
          "namespace": "review-production"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```bash
mono-agent validate
mono-agent start --foreground
```

The endpoint defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:4312/mcp`. Enable bearer auth even
on loopback when another local user or process is outside the trust boundary:

```bash
export MONO_AGENT_ADVISOR_REQUIRE_BEARER=true
export MONO_AGENT_ADVISOR_BEARER_TOKEN='replace-with-a-random-secret'
```

See the [Advisor MCP channel guide](../../docs/channels/advisor.md) for Codex,
Claude Code, and private Tailscale Serve registration plus the complete config
and error contracts.

## Architecture

### Data flow

1. The config-loaded channel driver validates plugin JSON plus env overrides,
   then starts one loopback-by-default HTTP listener with the host responder.
2. Host, Origin, bearer, framing, content-type, protocol-header, and body-size
   checks run before the MCP SDK receives a request.
3. A fresh stateless MCP transport registers only `review_iteration`. The tool
   normalizes and hashes `(namespace, session_key)`, admits at most one active
   call per continuity plus the global cap, and builds a containment prompt.
4. Agent-app applies the exact advisor model/effort for that request and
   replaces all host tools and MCP servers with an empty policy. A model
   selection rejection or provider failover is a visible failure, never an
   accepted fallback review.
5. Output and errors are bounded and redacted. Disconnect, timeout, and server
   shutdown abort the run, then stop/drain through bounded cleanup deadlines.

### Package structure

| Source module | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| [`channel-driver.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/channel-driver.ts) | Config-first plugin lifecycle and responder adaptation. |
| [`config.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/config.ts) | Bounded JSON/env configuration, network safety, and secret-redacted views. |
| [`server.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/server.ts) | Streamable HTTP listener, request policy, stateless transport, and bounded shutdown. |
| [`mcp-server.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/mcp-server.ts) | Single-tool MCP registration and request cancellation composition. |
| [`protocol.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/protocol.ts) | Input/output schemas, stable result codes, continuity IDs, and byte fitting. |
| [`execution.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/execution.ts) | Admission, timeout/cancellation races, exact-once lifecycle, and structured failures. |
| [`continuity.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/continuity.ts) | Bounded metadata-only continuity cache with TTL/LRU eviction. |
| [`redaction.ts`](https://github.com/robertsreberski/mono-agent/blob/main/extras/advisor-mcp/src/redaction.ts) | High-confidence credential and private-path output redaction. |

## Public API

### Start here

| API | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `createChannelDriver` / `createAdvisorChannelDriver` | Load the endpoint through `channels.plugins[]`. |
| `startAdvisorServer` | Start the hardened HTTP endpoint around a custom `AdvisorRunFactory`. |
| `createAdvisorMcpServer` | Embed the single tool into a caller-owned MCP transport. |
| `createAdvisorRunFactoryFromResponder` | Adapt a structural `AgentResponder` to advisor run lifecycle. |
| `loadAdvisorConfig` / `redactAdvisorConfig` | Validate plugin/env settings or render them without the bearer secret. |
| `executeReviewIteration` | Run the bounded protocol directly after caller-owned validation. |

## Dependency Boundary

Depends only on `@mono-agent/agent-contracts` plus Express, the MCP SDK, and
Zod. It does not depend on the harness, app, config package, another adapter,
memory, or an operator surface. Agent-app recognizes trusted advisor request
metadata to apply the request-scoped model and no-tools boundary.

## What This Package Does Not Own

It does not choose a default model or effort, read caller filesystem paths,
apply patches, run verification commands, upload credentials, expose arbitrary
tools, broaden host policy, authenticate via forwarded proxy headers, add a
package-owned review-body store, or claim a separately isolated agent process.
It never accepts a provider fallback as the configured advisor's review. Do not
submit credentials: the host responder may retain request/review content under
its configured history, artifact, observability, or memory policy.
